title: AV & Hybrid Event Systems
summary: Hands-on audio/visual setup and hybrid event production, from a home test environment to running live speaker events.
description: A hybrid A/V test environment built with Zoom and OBS to practice multi-source stream routing and audio mixing, using the same technical stack as production hybrid event support. That experience carried directly into producing and running in-person cybersecurity workshops and speaker events as Vice President of ISACA NY Metro Chapter's Yeshiva University student group, handling A/V setup and teardown, projector and display systems, livestream support, and event troubleshooting for 5+ events a semester.
